SELECT 
    COALESCE(art.artdynasty, 'ALL DYNASTIES') AS dynasty,
    SUM(ra.conservepriorityscore) AS total_conservation_priority_index,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS adequate_funding_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS insufficient_funding_count,
    AVG(cm.maintbudgetstatus) AS budget_efficiency_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) > 0 
        OR COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.maintbudgetstatus = 'Depleted' THEN 1 END) > 0 
        THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
        ELSE 'Within Budget' 
    END AS budget_status
FROM 
    artifactscore art
JOIN 
    riskassessments ra ON art.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
JOIN 
    conservationandmaintenance cm ON art.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
GROUP BY 
    art.artdynasty WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY 
    dynasty;
